昨天玩了demo，今天正式版上了直接就入了。射击手感尚可，内容量还行，价位仅个人能接受，战斗爽感在初期不太够，在点了部分局外成长和对怪的熟悉度高了之后，爽感逐步上升，开始爽射。 FPS射击rogue，武器技能战斗在关卡中的升级逻辑类似Hades的祝福build，而非枪火重生那样的经典rogue掉落式装备+局内升级强化。由于我的电脑长期未换配置落后，所以我除了后处理、纹理、场景细节等画面选项为中/高外其他均调为低或关闭，其他评论说的优化差感觉不是很明显，联机方面目前没遇到问题，影响游戏体验的恶性bug也没遇到。 就目前的体验来说，以枪械直接输出为标准的情况下，雷、冰的祝福会比较强，打dot的话，灵魂祝福会比较强，强化目前我只试过武器强化技能强化全部没有试过。关卡方面，总共有四关，神庙→花园→圣殿→皇家深渊，每一关都是中间一个精英boss最后一个关底boss的搭配，关底boss的路上必定会有需要钥匙才能进的商人房，平时路上也会随机出现商人房。 全武器解锁，霰弹枪→击败第一关神庙关底boss后传送门旁边的桌子上，电击枪→击败第二关花园精英boss后传送门旁边的桌子上，左轮→在玩家大厅中灵魂之轮旁边帐篷里，飞盘枪→击败第二关花园关底boss后掉落到一个下水道中击碎四个藏在管道里的水晶打开隐藏房间获得，弓箭→快速击败第三关圣殿精英boss在传送门旁边的岔路尽头获得，等离子发射器→快速抵达第四关时初始点有个被深坑隔断的房间(30分钟可以拿到，晚了不知道行不行)，鱼神→第四关有三种不同的精英boss多次抵达第四关每种精英boss都杀过一次后在玩家大厅-"邀请朋友到大厅"帐篷区左后方瀑布后的隐藏山洞中有个可触发石门的隐藏房间里获得 全道具解锁，锚→第二关花园中的钥匙房初次开可以在房间中间捡到，炮台→击败第一关神庙的boss，远古核心→击败第二关boss后在玩家大厅的收藏室最深处有一个房间可以捡到，盐水场→第三关第二节初始房间中石柱跳跳乐获得 后补充：正式版4小时就玩这么透是因为demo已经玩了9小时了，屯了很多用于局外成长的灵魂，写评论时只是通了三次关，正式版才能解锁的武器除了左轮都还没怎么试； 目前祝福试下来和demo强度差距不大，火祝福比demo里感觉要强好多，联机的时候触手祝福会很厉害因为后面可以给玩家叠buff大家互相叠左脚踩右脚，冰、电、灵魂祝福仍旧很强； 武器方面，感觉只有初始步枪过于平庸没什么可玩性，其他武器都不错； 后多解锁条件在成就日志里都可以看到，弓箭应该是要20s还是30s速杀第三关的精英那条岔路的门才会打开，等离子发射器在30分钟左右到达第四关复活点旁边有个小岔路跃过深坑抵达房间可以捡到，可能条件数值有误差，但大概是这样，我之前理解和表达有问题很抱歉

[h1]能合唱的生化枪火克苏鲁奇兵DOOM重生[/h1] [h2]打着怪唱着歌，《深渊之潮》多欢乐？[/h2] 4K HDR实况：https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV12ZbjzUEg7 [h2]游戏概况[/h2] 《深渊之潮》是一款高潜力的肉鸽射击游戏，以盐朋克美术风格、武器构筑策略和合作玩法为亮点。首发期因联机闪退、内容量争议影响口碑，但核心玩法扎实，适合与好友组队体验。后期若优化内容和平衡，有望成为品类标杆。 [h2]推荐指数★★★★（4/5）[/h2] - 评分理由：肉鸽射击+合作体验优秀，首发联机bug已通过8小时内补丁修复，但内容量略单薄。4星适合尝鲜，后期更新可冲5星。 [h2]推荐理由[/h2] - 玩法创新：盐朋克美术沉浸感强，Build策略深度高，合作欢乐性突出 - 核心体验：无弹药限制射击解压，隐藏内容丰富，难度曲线合理 - 优化表现：低配设备流畅运行，音效与打击感出色 - 后续潜力：NG+机制提升重复可玩性，官方修复问题及时 [h2]推荐人群[/h2] - 喜欢[i]《Gunfire Reborn》[/i]《Roboquest》的合作肉鸽玩家 - 偏爱蒸汽朋克/海底探险美术的视觉党 - 能接受前期坐牢、享受Build成就感的硬核玩家 [h2]不适合人群[/h2] - 单人玩家（后期难度偏高） - 对价格敏感（期待100小时内容量者慎入） - 反感强制合作（依赖联机功能但无好友者） [hr][/hr] [h2]核心内容总结[/h2] - 共424条玩家评论（约8.5万字），评论日期集中在2025年8月12日-14日（首发后48小时内） - 包含玩家推荐/不推荐状态、游戏时长、评论文本及互动数据，反映游戏首发期核心口碑 [h2]基础统计[/h2] [b]推荐/不推荐数量[/b]： - 推荐354条（83.49%），不推荐70条（16.51%） - 推荐比例显著高于不推荐，负面集中在首发联机bug和内容量争议 [b]时长统计[/b]： - 推荐玩家：最长154.9小时，平均6.35小时，中位数5.3小时（多数玩家深度体验） - 不推荐玩家：最长13小时，平均3.35小时，中位数1.4小时（多数因早期闪退/优化问题放弃） [b]语种分布[/b]： - 中文208条（49.06%），英文182条（42.92%），俄语22条（5.19%），其他12条（2.83%） - 好评率排序：俄语（100%推荐，样本少）> 中文（84.6%）> 英文（82.4%）> 其他 [hr][/hr] [h2]优点汇总（按提及频次排序）[/h2] [h3]1. 玩法创新性与独特性[/h3] - [b]“盐朋克”美术与沉浸感[/b]：海底蒸汽朋克风格、Boss战演出（如第三关圣殿BOSS的触手特效）、隐藏彩蛋（如水下跳跳乐密室）——对比[i]《Bioshock》[/i] - [b]Build策略深度[/b]：武器祝福（电/冰/火）+ 局外成长组合，如“特斯拉枪+霜冻祝福”秒冻精英怪，玩家称“肉鸽构筑爽感拉满” - [b]合作欢乐性[/b]：4人联机分工（治疗/输出/控场），灵魂之轮共享钥匙、复活机制，“和朋友唱歌同步踩点打Boss”成梗 [h3]2. 核心玩法[/h3] - [b]无弹药限制射击[/b]：无限备弹+双模式武器（霰弹枪右键破盾/左轮蓄力穿透），玩家反馈“突突突解压，比[i]《Gunfire Reborn》[/i]更爽快” - [b]隐藏内容丰富[/b]：12种武器需特定条件解锁（如飞盘枪需击碎管道水晶），30+隐藏成就，“每次跑图都有新发现” - [b]难度曲线合理[/b]：前期坐牢（无解锁）→ 中期爽射（局外成长）→ 后期挑战（Brine Tank难度系统），“像[i]《Hades》[/i]一样越死越强” [h3]3. 品质表现[/h3] - [b]优化与性能[/b]：低配流畅（GTX1060稳60帧），场景细节（水下光影、废墟纹理），“比[i]《Witchfire》[/i]优化好太多” - [b]音效与演出[/b]：Boss战语音（如“感受深海的愤怒！”）、武器打击感（电击枪滋滋声），“开枪震屏反馈超带感” [h3]4. 重复可玩性[/h3] - [b]NG+机制[/b]：Brine Tank增加敌人特效（如自爆蛙带毒雾），4种终章精英轮换，“每次选不同挑战像玩新游戏” [hr][/hr] [h2]问题汇总（按提及频次排序）[/h2] [h3]1. 基础体验[/h3] - [b]联机闪退（当前已修复）[/b]：首发“查找小队必崩”（70%差评主因），需通过Steam邀请绕开，“说好的4人联机，结果成了好友专属游戏” - [b]存档bug[/b]：部分玩家进度丢失（如Demo存档继承失败），“10小时成就全没，直接劝退” [h3]2. 核心玩法[/h3] - [b]Boss设计便秘[/b]：水元素Boss多段AOE+毒池，闪避无无敌帧，“像在玩[i]《只狼》[/i]但没弹反” - [b]武器失衡[/b]：特斯拉枪/锚超模，实弹枪（如初始机枪）刮痧，“电系Build占比80%，其他武器成摆设” [h3]3. 内容量完成度[/h3] - [b]关卡重复度高[/b]：4大关流程固定（神庙→花园→圣殿→深渊），精英/Boss战机制重复，“第5次打同一只青蛙Boss想吐” - [b]价格争议[/b]：74元售价被批“内容不如Demo丰富”，“对比[i]《Roboquest》[/i]差了两个DLC的量” [h3]4. 上手门槛[/h3] - [b]新手引导缺失[/b]：隐藏武器无提示（如左轮需大厅帐篷），祝福效果描述模糊，“玩3小时才知道右键能换模式” [hr][/hr] [h2]玩家诉求（按提及频次排序）[/h2] - [b]联机优化[/b]：修复服务器浏览器，增加断线重连（当前已修复） - [b]内容扩展[/b]：新增5+关卡，通用祝福联动（如火+冰融化增伤） - [b]平衡调整[/b]：削弱超模武器（特斯拉枪），增强实弹枪 - [b]体验优化[/b]：闪避无敌帧延长，Boss技能前摇提示 - [b]新手引导[/b]：隐藏内容指引，祝福效果可视化 [hr][/hr] [h2]玩家提及类似游戏[/h2] https://store.steampowered.com/app/548430/Deep_Rock_Galactic/ 深岩银河：4人合作矮人射爆，动态地形+随机任务，支持Mod扩展，以“挖矿爽、射爆爽、队友互坑更爽”闻名。 https://store.steampowered.com/app/1217060/_/ 枪火重生：国产肉鸽标杆，武器+元素组合深度极高，支持1-4人联机，以“一局一Build”的随机爽感和水墨风格著称。 https://store.steampowered.com/app/692890/Roboquest/ Roboquest：快节奏双武器肉鸽，无限弹药+动态难度，以“爽射+跑图”为核心，玩家高频对比其“爽感与联机体验”。

All in all, I think the game has alot of potential, but as of right now the devs desperately need to focus on rebalancing.

The game is fun, but it's limited in its current state. The weapon customization is limited, the blessings are very cookie cutter and uninspired, the content is lacking for a game of its price. The game may be set in the Abyss, but the gameplay is shallow. There are positives. The game controls smoothly enough for a standard shooter and the challenge-unlocks are meaningful and can be obtained in a reasonable time. The game looks good in a sense, but it is also another drab stone temple. But the game is failing at moment to moment interest, per-run powers and the meta-progression tree. Guns are very simple weapons and the player has only one at a time. The player has little to do when playing but fire/alt-fire, and grenade power. The alt fire is just a slightly modified gun power, like scope or overheat shot. There's no complex interactions or tension between abilities. In fact, the heat system might encourage grenade throwing, but otherwise it put the player in a situation where they have less to do. Enemies, all of which are all samey colored, don't have fun interactions either. There's a lot of chasing the player, forcing the player to run backwards which might lead into more enemies. It's pretty much impossible for the player to enforce their will on the enemy except by killing them. Enemies frequently dive bomb the player when at low health, which means the player can't get caught in a reload or the have to run even more. It's all very playable and doable with skill, but not very interesting compared to other shooting games. The gods' blessing style powers are astoundingly boring. They're almost entirely "your primary/secondary/ability deals 15% extra damage and gains/has a chance of applying <ability that I never notice>. It says a lot when I don't care at all about the powers. The meta progression tree is unbalanced and dull. At level 1 you have 1 obvious "gain 1 heal" abilty, and when you see this the tree looks interesting, but then the rest are all "4-5% damage boost for one of the three categories", a bonus more like a dot on a WoW build with little feeling of moving forward. Compared to the competition, the game is not close.

《深渊之潮》在发售前就以Demo吸引到不少玩家的关注，盐水朋克+肉鸽构筑+FPS合作的头衔让列表里的三三两两的好友在游戏刚一上线就开始组队开潮。不过也就实说，在撇开合作体验之后本作的重复度高以及内容单薄问题表现的非常突出，难度曲线和局外成长的提升不够平滑，在内容设计倾向上本作也显然的并不太适宜单人孤狼玩家游玩。相信在后续更新下《深渊之潮》成为第一梯队的类型游戏，但目前而言，它更像是款半成品游戏 [h2] 非EA的半成品 [/h2] 《深渊之潮》的小怪和Boss种类都被完全固定在对应的关卡内，所谓的肉鸽局内随机性也更多的只是指局内的祝福，但祝福的平衡也显见做的并不算太好，在最开始的尝鲜体验后玩家也往往只会选择最轮椅的几个。重复的开局重复的怪物重复的体验，目的只是为了解锁不同的武器模组，这样明显欠缺的新鲜感提供我并不认为目前的《深渊之潮》能为玩家持续性消费 在局外没有完全成型之前单人玩家相当难通过关卡，本作的节奏快也更多的只是指怪物的攻击欲望高连带着玩家需要以很高的频次闪避反击，这一点在Boss战中的体验格外差，Boss普遍的大范围多样机制让玩家的精力完全被如何运用仅有的二段跳和闪避躲避，可供攻击的时机相当欠缺，并且Boss强行堆血量的方式让很多时候过关变成了刮痧熬时间 简要的来看，《深渊之潮》的致命缺点就是内容单薄之下的有限随机性，肉鸽元素如果让人玩起来感觉一眼望的到头那也实在过于致命了。循环机制本身就对内容量有颇高的要求，而在这方面《深渊之潮》表现的也过于半成品。并且奖励反馈也并不显性，所支撑的仅有祝福和开箱出的金币、护符，大部分的战斗几乎没有任何的奖励唯有重复。视觉效果有特色但较为粗糙，显然在画面表现力上来看该点也不足以成为能长期支撑玩家进行循环体验的要素，在环境元素上玩家也没有更多可以互动到的部分，每次基本上只是进入关卡出怪打完下一关依次重复，关卡内一点能让玩家驻足的多余内容也不存在 出自 网易 UU 鉴赏家培训计划 感谢由网易 UU 加速器免费提供的游戏 你出内容我出游戏，携手共创优质内容

[h2] Not Recommended: Demo Promised More, Full Game Falls Short [/h2] The demo for Abyssus hooked me with its brinepunk FPS action after a few hours of play, but after 25 hours in the full game, it feels like Early Access. Repetitive runs, shallow systems, and a lack of depth make it hard to recommend at full price. The core is solid, and the roadmap promises more, but it needs serious work to stand out. [b] Value for Money [/b] The demo was so exciting that I expected a deep roguelite adventure. Instead, the full game adds little beyond it, feeling thin for a full release. At the current price, it lacks the variety and surprises I expect from roguelikes, which often deliver fresh runs through diverse builds. The Soul Wheel grind for unlocks like healing shrines is sluggish, and repetitive loops don’t justify the cost. I’d suggest waiting for a bigger sale or updates for better value. [b] Combat and Gunplay [/b] The shooting and movement are smooth and fun, with weapons like the Tesla, Bow, and Revolver standing out. The shotgun, though, feels like a toy, lacking impact. Visual clutter is a big issue: enemies with two to five modifiers, plus extra bars from effects like Frost, make screens chaotic, especially on small maps. Duo co-op is great, but with three or four players, cramped spaces cause collisions and stray hits, making dodging a mess. [b] Progression and Build Variety [/b] This is Abyssus’s weakest spot. Upgrades lock you into focusing on one part of your kit, primary attack, secondary, or ability, stifling creativity. For example, forging the Anchor into an exploding throwable is cool but forces you to spam it over guns. In other roguelikes, like Risk of Rain 2 or Slay the Spire, upgrades spark exciting combos and varied playstyles. Aspects here just boost damage without synergies, missing chances for fun builds. Merchant costs climb as you progress, but gold stays scarce, making upgrades feel out of reach. The Soul Wheel adds passive changes, but runs still blend together. [b] Exploration and Level Design [/b] Exploration is almost nonexistent. Every run follows the same linear path, room after room, with no branching routes or meaningful secrets. Small secrets, like weapon unlocks, exist but don’t inspire discovery. Objectives like “shoot targets” or “stand in zones” grow stale quickly. All areas reuse layouts, making early levels tedious, though the final Aztec pyramid zone, with its bold red-and-white design, looks stunning. Roguelikes with varied paths, like Slay the Spire’s branching choices, keep runs fresh, but Abyssus feels predictable. [b] Visuals, Story, and Performance [/b] The brinepunk art style has potential, but only the final Aztec-inspired zones, with their striking red-and-white pyramids, stand out; early areas feel bland. Performance is solid, with one crash in 25 hours and no frame drops, even in chaos. The story, though, is a bust. Books offer vague phrases or Easter eggs, like one saying, “How many expeditions is this now? 33? That’s 33 too many,” nodding to Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. It’s a cute reference but not actual lore, leaving the world feeling empty. [b] Final Thoughts [/b] Abyssus has fun co-op moments, but repetitive runs, shallow builds, and no exploration or story make it fade fast. At the current price, it doesn’t match the lasting variety of other roguelikes. As a new release, it has room to grow, and updates could make it great. I’ll check back then, but for now, I’d suggest skipping it unless you’re after a short co-op romp.

One of the sadder "Not Recommends" for me. I think there is so much good and so much future potential for this game, but it feels like an "Early Access" title in disguise as a full release. Bugs are plenty - from weird UI elements like timers that don't move, to health bar desyncs, to being forced to sprint into a wall. And they aren't the kind you can ignore, they actively hinder your experience. Outside of bugs, there are also just unfun/unpolished elements of the game that leave you more frustrated causing losses that are out of your control. I think the worst offenders are the objective based maps specifically the escorts or the 2 man charge plate. These would be fine, but there's 0 time to breathe and enemy spawns are so unintelligently implemented that can spawn on top of your character as you're on an objective (like legit inside your hitbox). The second worst offender is Boss projectiles, sometimes they just spawn inside or on you as their starting point for a sweeping or circular motion. Its out of the players control to prevent this, so you better like to eat damage on an otherwise easily telegraphed boss attack. I really do like the game, but seeing it at 90% positive I wanted to make sure my review can be a warning for people thinking this is a finished/polished product. [b] EDIT - 1/14/26 [/b] - Since some people were asking what I thought about the patch I thought I'd update with some thoughts. (Disclosure I only played 2 runs) -New Boss variants are a great way to mix things up and give the game some new life for returning plays -Boss patterns feel a little better but you'll still get the classic half-map explosion that spawns on you with not enough time to escape. -Bugs are different but not entirely fixed. For example my health bar was no longer desynced but the visual looked half full when I had max HP. Sprinting while pressing tab still sends you into an uncontrollable sprint into a wall or off a ledge. You can still get locked out of the final boss fight but they added a button to teleport in now lol. -Since updating I now seem to have both a micro stutter that is ever persistent (like a tiny rubberband) and larger stutters that seem random. Saw the devs are aware of these issues. I would say its definitely feeling better from both a QoL and variety perspective, but be aware of these issues. Ultimately its up to you on whether they're deal breakers.

It does have some minor flaws, like enemies being super spongey and there being no protection when entering a room full of enemies. Definitely get it on discount if you are a fan of roguelites. I'd like to add that it does get boring faster than I thought it would, but it's still worth getting it for what it offers.

Solid game. It's like if DOOM Eternal was a roguelite. The guns are excellent, the action is fast paced. The bossfights are more of a mixed bag, some are good but some are kind of annoying as they spam a ton of effects everywhere. This leads to me attempting to stat-check them a lot instead of engaging with the mechanics. I've had a blast over these 30 hours and I expect to get around 20 more out of the game before I get bored. I already consider that good value for the 15 euros I paid. However I could easily play way more if the developers add more alternate stages and add some special interactions between different blessings. Right now it feels like you really want to go all-in on a single blessing as your damage option, and then the other two blessings are there to support with minimal investment. This has led to me taking Shadow and Frost a lot more than anything else, because those two excel at providing the utility to compliment whatever my main damage blessing is. I think something like Hades' combo boon system would go a long way toward incentivizing more variety. Edit: I'm disappointed they removed some of the depth from the game. Instead of choosing which meta-progression perks you will use, you now get to use them all. I enjoyed tailoring my perk loadout to suit the build I was aiming for, now that avenue for decision making is gone and players get to be significantly more powerful, making the game easier. Apparently this was how it worked before, and them reverting it is a response to review bombing of angry players. Well I think they devs had the right idea, and it's unfortunate they were forced to make their game worse because a few players couldn't handle having their power level slightly reduced in the name of improving the game in the long run. I'd still recommend the game overall but I've personally lost interest for now.
